# OptimalRepresentationCriticality

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The condition where a neural network at criticality achieves the most efficient encoding of input information, maximizing mutual information while minimizing redundancy. This guides iNEST designs toward neuromorphic systems that naturally learn optimal representations, improving energy efficiency and generalization in in-network processing.
